rows.note: Use 講座 as the all-purpose noun for an organized lecture or explanatory talk.

example.english: There’s a lecture about artificial intelligence at the university tonight.
example.traditional: 今晚大學有個關於人工智能嘅講座。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 daai6 hok6 jau5 go3 gwaan1 jyu1 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 ge3 gong2 zo6

rows.note: Use 一輪鬧 for the colloquial noun phrase meaning a bout of scolding or telling-off.

example.english: Mum gave me a lecture for being ten minutes late.
example.traditional: 我遲到十分鐘，畀阿媽一輪鬧。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ci4 dou3 sap6 fan1 zung1 bei2 aa3 maa1 jat1 leon4 naau6

rows.note: Use 堂 when lecture means a regular class period, especially at school or university.

example.english: We have an economics lecture every Wednesday.
example.traditional: 我哋逢星期三都有經濟堂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 fung4 sing1 kei4 saam1 dou1 jau5 ging1 zai3 tong4
